title: CSV Data Analyzer
description:
```
$ analyze sales.csv --group region --sum revenue --sort desc
Region     Revenue      Orders
North    $1,204,550.00    3,201
South      $998,210.50    2,870
```
requirements: Parse CSV with quoted fields (`"Smith, John"`)
Column type detection; values as `std::variant<std::monostate, long long, double, std::string>`
Draw an ASCII bar chart of the result
Handle malformed rows with clear error messages (line numbers)
